profile: Game

tModLoader 1.4.4.9, only the read-only TerrariaBenchObserver 0.7 journal; unmodified rules (normal PvE, hostile damage on); starter-item random prefixes reset to none; DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT=1 (lighting on the calling thread; fixes the paused-clock crash).
Worlds
fresh copies of small Classic worlds 32000401 (crimson), 32000402 (crimson), 32000403 (corruption, unseen by every earlier run).
Display
1024×1024 window, zoom 100 %, UI 0.9, Color lighting, framed minimap, Smart Cursor on (one stock Left Ctrl press before the first screenshot). Enforced by the profile (other values are rejected).
Interface

one act(actions) tool (1-16 key/mouse/wait primitives, Appendix B; identical to default-v1); every act returns {"dispatched_commands", "game_time_played", "image_follows"} + a fresh JPEG q85 screenshot.
System prompt

goal + "The session lasts exactly N minutes of game time and cannot be ended early." + "Every reply must call the act tool." + Terraria's default key bindings (Appendix A). No hints, recipes, progress feedback or remaining time. Identical in both clock modes.
Context
all text and tool results (until 120k tokens, then oldest whole turns dropped); newest 8 screenshots (dropped 8 at a time).
No-action rule

Tool call forced where the API supports it: GPT-5.6 Responses tool_choice: "required"; Claude with thinking off tool_choice: {"type": "any"}; Claude with thinking on cannot be forced (API rejects it) and stays at the default. Any reply without a valid act call (no tool call, invalid arguments, unknown tool) is executed as wait 1000 ms; the game advances 1 s in both clock modes; and the next user turn is a fresh screenshot introduced by No action was taken. Counted per run (no-action.jsonl, result.no_action_turns). No continuation message, no 5-in-a-row stop, no invalid-call stop.
End

the game-time budget (game updates / 60 from the observer); a dollar / call cap → censored. Added during this campaign (after b08): the agent leaving the world via the game's Save & Exit ends the run (agent_left_world, remaining time forfeited, not censored); no game-time progress for 60 s of unfrozen time ends it as game_clock_stalled (censored).
Clock
realtime: the game never pauses. paused: the game process group is SIGSTOPped during every model call and resumed for actions, waits and screenshots.
Scoring

offline and hidden: published 13-checkpoint subset (terrariabench.com comparable) + extended catalog (19 facts: crafted / placed / looted, layers, ores, bars, furnace, anvil; tools/extended_score.py, cut at the budget).
Combination (Opus planner + Jev executor)

planner gets the default-v2 goal paragraph (with the session length) and the controls; it replies with JSON plans, not act calls. An executor turn without usable actions waits 1 s (game running) and counts as a no-action turn; no error-count stops.

harness.prompt:
You are playing Terraria on a fresh character in a fresh small Classic world. The game is unmodified: enemies,
damage, day and night follow the normal game rules. Your goal is to progress as far as possible toward defeating the
Wall of Flesh. The session lasts exactly {minutes} minutes of game time and cannot be ended early.

You see the game through {width}x{height} screenshots and control it with the act tool, which sends ordinary keyboard and
mouse input to the game window and then returns a new screenshot and the game time played so far. Every reply must
call the act tool.

Controls (Terraria's default key bindings):
- A / D: move left / right. W: move up (climb ropes). S: move down (drop through platforms).
- Space: jump (hold longer to jump higher).
- Left mouse button: use the selected item at the mouse cursor (swing, mine, chop, place).
- Right mouse button: interact (open doors and chests, talk to townspeople, equip items from the inventory).
- 1-9 and 0: select hotbar slots 1-10.
- Escape: open / close the inventory (including the crafting menu).
- Left Ctrl: toggle Smart Cursor. Left Shift (hold): auto select.
- H: quick heal. J: quick mana. B: quick buff. E: grapple. R: quick mount. T: throw the selected item.
- M: full-screen map. Tab: change the minimap style.
harness.prompt_note: {minutes} = 20 (40 for the long runs); {width}x{height} = 1024x1024. First user turn: 'Current game screenshot:' plus the opening screenshot.

 {
  "type": "function",
  "function": {
   "name": "act",
   "description": "Send keyboard and mouse input to the game, then return a new screenshot and the game time played. The actions run in order.
